purpose: Remove the host-mount qualification gap that allowed the deployed WebSocket image to pass locally without its required partial-transcript source.

root_cause.live_behavior: The WebSocket transport and start exchange reached the session constructor, which attempted to load a synthetic partial-transcript fixture absent from the deployed image and failed closed with code 4503.
root_cause.file_path_difference: The file route never constructs SyntheticPartialSource, so the preserved file proof could pass while streaming refused.
root_cause.qualification_gap: The previous local image qualifier mounted platform/testdata over the image and supplied the missing file from the host, so it did not test the deployable image filesystem.

prospective_changes.local_negative_qualification: Run the real container with the partial-source path deliberately absent and require fail-closed readiness before running the aligned full streamed conversation.

allowed_operations: Local runtime qualification and vulnerability scan
Preparation of a versioned scan-only ECR packet
prohibited_without_separate_exact_packet: Push the successor image to ECR
Change production SSM, approved/asr, MLflow or model-registry state
